Portfolio figures

Data notes

    Assumptions

    Returns are treated as annual compound returns and each distribution is log-normal. Published standard deviations and correlations are taken as those of annual simple returns and converted to their log-return equivalents. Portfolio figures assume continuous rebalancing to the selected weights. Beyond one year the dashed line is the arithmetic mean return per annum, not the mean of the annualised return distribution shown. For one year and less it is that mean. In the growth and final-value views the bars show the distribution of the cumulative outcome over the horizon; the solid line marks its median and the dashed line its mean. Source: CMA Data 2026.xlsx. Source assumptions are 10 years forecasts. Other horizons, including 1 and 3 months, rescale those forecasts rather than use forecasts made for that horizon.
